decision: Cam 2026-10-18, "Map + models, scoped" (C5 in apps/map/docs/PEOPLE.md, Athletes), as the rules table in AGENTS.md words it. The same decision is data/athletes/allowlist.json's, which checks athlete/1 records; this file is the check at record/1.
exception: Professional athletes only by Cam's 2026-10-18 exception: name, team, team city, arena, season, school, birthplace city, region and country, every field cited; never a birth date, age, address, family, contact or health
personTypedCollectionsNote: A collection whose records are people. Joined by a reviewed change to this list, like PUBLIC_NAME_COLLECTIONS in validate.mjs. validate.mjs cannot tell that a collection is made of people, so one nobody lists here is not read by this rule. Athletes are the only people allowed (the exception above); nobody else is added.
allowedFieldsNote: The details keys a person-typed record may carry: data/athletes/allowlist.json's record fields, no more and no fewer (data/schema/validate.test.mjs holds the two equal). A key matches however it is spelled: teamCity, team_city and "team city" are one name. A birthplace is joined by Wikidata QID and P131 when the record is built (rule A5a) and has no field of its own here. The envelope fields of record/1 (id, name, geometry, place, provenance and so on) are record.schema.json's business, not this list's.
forbiddenPatternsNote: Names that never appear on a person-typed record, in details or anywhere else in it, nested included. The first fifteen are the starting list; birthday, age, children, contact and health are the exception's own words (and one plural). A name matches when its words, split at case changes, underscores, hyphens and spaces, hold a pattern's words in a row, a final s or es ignored: home_address and spouseName match, stage and adobe do not match age and dob. This names the reason; a details key off the allowed list fails anyway, and a pattern wins over the allowed list.
